data_point: Open role for operations, business operations or chief of staff
run_when: Job titles are available and one may be an ops role.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company has an open operations, business operations or chief-of-staff role, the function that usually inherits the books before a finance hire.
yes_when: An open role titled Operations, BizOps, Business Operations, Chief of Staff or Office Manager
no_when: Open roles are listed and none are ops roles
watch_out_for: DevOps, Security Operations and Sales Operations are not business operations

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.
